faqs.title: Frequently Asked
faqs.calloutDescription: Can’t find the answer you’re looking for? Our team is here to help you with any cybersecurity-related inquiries.

items.question: What cybersecurity services do you provide?
items.answer: We provide threat detection and response, vulnerability assessment, data security and encryption, cloud security, identity and access management, 24/7 security monitoring (SOC), compliance and risk management, and expert consulting and advisory.

items.question: How do you protect businesses from cyber attacks?
items.answer: We use a combination of proactive monitoring, threat detection, vulnerability management, and robust security controls to identify, prevent, and respond to cyber threats in real time.

items.question: Do you offer 24/7 security monitoring?
items.answer: Yes. Our Security Operations Center (SOC) monitors your environment around the clock, so threats are detected and handled quickly, day or night.

items.question: Is my company data safe with your services?
items.answer: Absolutely. We follow strict access controls, encryption standards and industry best practices, and we keep your data confidential at every stage of our engagement.

items.question: Do you provide cybersecurity for small businesses?
items.answer: Yes. We offer flexible and scalable solutions designed for organizations of every size, from startups and small businesses to large enterprises.
